structures.name: skin
structures.label: Skin
structures.description: Full adult body surface in a neutral pose, smoothed to a clinical-mannequin look.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy body-surface region patches, joined, voxel-remeshed and smoothed; hair, nails and external genitalia removed.

structures.name: brain
structures.label: Brain (cerebral hemispheres)
structures.source: Z-Anatomy 'White matter of telencephalon' (left + right). Cerebellum not included.

structures.name: brainstem
structures.label: Brainstem
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Midbrain, Pons, Medulla oblongata (left + right halves).

structures.name: hypothalamus
structures.label: Hypothalamus
structures.description: Hypothalamus of the diencephalon; controls body temperature, hunger, thirst, sleep and hormone release via the pituitary.

structures.name: spinal_cord
structures.label: Spinal cord
structures.description: Spinal cord from the medulla to the conus medullaris.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy White matter of spinal cord.

structures.name: vagus
structures.label: Vagus nerve (CN X)
structures.description: Left and right vagus nerves, from the brainstem down through the neck and thorax.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Vagus nerve (X), left + right, re-tubed at low resolution.

structures.name: phrenic
structures.label: Phrenic nerves
structures.description: Left and right phrenic nerves, neck to diaphragm; they drive the diaphragm for breathing.
structures.source: NOT in Z-Anatomy. Path approximated from source anatomy: down the front of scalenus anterior, along the side of the heart, onto the diaphragm dome.

structures.name: arm_nerve
structures.label: Brachial plexus & median nerve
structures.description: Brachial plexus and median nerve of both arms.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy brachial plexus roots, trunks, divisions and posterior cord, plus median nerve. The lateral and medial cords are absent from the source.

structures.name: auditory_nerve
structures.label: Vestibulocochlear nerve (CN VIII)
structures.description: Hearing and balance nerve, both sides.

structures.name: ears
structures.label: Inner ear
structures.description: Cochlea and vestibular apparatus (balance organ), both sides.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Cochlea + Vestibule. Possibly derived from a CC BY-NC-SA model; see LICENSE.txt.

structures.name: heart
structures.label: Heart
structures.description: The four chambers of the heart.

structures.name: aorta
structures.label: Aorta
structures.description: Aortic root, arch and descending (thoracic + abdominal) aorta.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Ascending aorta, Aortic arch, Thoracic aorta, Abdominal aorta.

structures.name: arm_artery
structures.label: Left arm artery
structures.description: Left subclavian, axillary and brachial artery, continuing to the wrist.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Left subclavian, Axillary (L), Brachial (L), Radial (L) arteries.

structures.name: lungs
structures.label: Lungs
structures.source: Z-Anatomy lobes of left and right lung.

structures.name: trachea
structures.label: Trachea & main bronchi
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Trachea, Left and Right main bronchus.

structures.name: marrow
structures.label: Pelvis & femurs (bone marrow)
structures.description: Hip bones and both femurs, major sites of red bone marrow; relevant to bone-density loss in spaceflight.
structures.source: Z-Anatomy Hip bone (L/R) and Femur (L/R). Sacrum is in spine_bones.

structures.name: spine_bones
structures.label: Spine & rib cage
structures.description: Vertebral column (C1 to coccyx) and rib cage (ribs, costal cartilages, sternum).
structures.source: Z-Anatomy vertebrae, sacrum, coccyx, 24 ribs, costal cartilages, sternum. Intervertebral discs not included.
